title: r1 #19 carry-forward: real-person name 'Grace Kelly' still in the client demo fixture — only the email and the PDF were swapped to Gráinne Foley
evidence: demo_fixtures.gleam:93 (verbatim fragments): "first_name\":\"Grace\",\"last_name\":\"Kelly\",\"email\":\"grainne.foley@example.ie\" ... \"has_eviction_history\":true,\"eviction_details\":\"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024\",\"has_ccjs\":true ... \"status\":\"rejected\"". demo_store.gleam:1435: #("a-grace", "RightTenantry-Report-Grace-Kelly.pdf"),. Contrast server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:212-213: "Gráinne", "Foley", and :424: applicant_name: "Gráinne Foley",. git diff c54c3c5..1c2a6a9 on demo_fixtures.gleam changes only grace.kelly@example.ie -> grainne.foley@example.ie; first_name/last_name are byte-identical.
detail: The r1 fix swapped the name only in the PDF prebake and the email. Every demo UI surface (leaderboard, applicant detail, filename) still shows 'Grace Kelly' — a famous real person — attached to eviction/CCJ/rejected data, and the on-screen name contradicts the downloaded report.
recommended_fix: Rename the fixture row to Gráinne/Gráinne Foley (first_name, last_name in app_grace_json and the demo_store.report_filenames entry), keeping the PDF as-is; the report and UI then agree.

title: No-network lint whitelists helpers as 'branch on demo_mode internally' that contain no demo branch — safety rests on caller interception the lint does not check
evidence: lint: DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS = { "submit_vacancy", "handle_vacancy_update", "handle_application_opened", "dispatch_status_update", "refetch_refcheck_effect", "fire_refcheck_slot_action", "fire_refcheck_call_action", "save_refcheck_edit", } above the comment "Helpers that branch on demo_mode internally (verified to carry the store)." — but client.gleam:6880 fn dispatch_status_update(model: Model, vid: String, aid: String, new_status: String) -> #(Model, Effect(Msg)) { #( Model(..model, loading_action: Some(LoadingStatusUpdate)), application_api.update_application_status(vid, aid, new_status, model.csrf_token, ApiReturnedStatusUpdate), ) } has no demo_mode branch (same for save_refcheck_edit, fire_refcheck_slot_action, fire_refcheck_call_action).
detail: These helpers are demo-safe only because their callers (UserChangedApplicationStatus, UserSavedRefcheckEdit, etc.) are intercepted in demo_update. A future arm calling them directly passes the lint while firing a real authenticated write from demo.
recommended_fix: Make the lint verify an internal demo_mode branch for whitelisted helpers (as it does for message arms), or add explicit demo branches inside the four helpers and drop the trust assumption.

title: r1 #24 carry-forward: demo mode still writes comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals to real web storage
evidence: client.gleam:4941-4944: UserDismissedSweepNudge(application_id) -> { let updated_dismissed = set.insert(model.dismissed_sweep_nudges, application_id) save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed)) — no demo_mode guard. client.gleam:3531-3532: True -> { let new_ids = list.filter(ids, fn(x) { x != id }) save_comparison_ids(new_ids) — no demo_mode guard; same at 3546, 5411, 5416 (the latter two inside handle_browser_change, which demo mode also runs).
detail: Synthetic demo ids persist into the real app's sessionStorage/localStorage keys, and load_comparison_ids() feeds them back on demo entry — a 'no persistence of any kind' scope exception. No network, no cross-user data.
recommended_fix: Skip the storage writes (and the load on demo entry) when model.demo_mode is True, or use demo-scoped keys.
